scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run bundle
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run dupes && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run bundle && bun run smoke
